name: computer_click
description: Click an element by index or pixel coordinates from screenshot. Use the latest observation_id and element_index. Verify the returned post-action state. If an error says the outcome is unknown, observe again before deciding whether to retry.

x.description: X coordinate in screenshot pixel coordinates

mouse_button.description: Mouse button to click. Defaults to left.

app.description: Exact app identifier from computer_find_apps/computer_list_apps: macOS bundle ID or Windows/Linux PID; start_app uses the discovered launch_id on Windows/Linux. AIClaw Computer Use owns the observed target window. Self/helper/approval UI cannot be controlled.

y.description: Y coordinate in screenshot pixel coordinates

observation_id.description: Copy observation_id from this app's latest computer_screenshot, computer_query or action result in this turn. Old observations and indexes cannot be reused.

key.description: Optional modifier combination: shift, ctrl, alt, super (use + between modifiers).

duration.description: Seconds to hold the mouse button before release.

verify_after.description: Defaults to true: capture post-action state. Set false for deterministic intermediate steps in exec; old observations are invalidated and you must query/observe again before another input. Capture and verify at decision points and completion. Never replay input after uncertain results.

interaction_mode.description: Defaults to foreground. Strict background supports semantic AX click, set_value without autosubmit, select_text, and secondary actions. On macOS, plain/Shift keys and bounded literal text also require a fresh screenshot proving the same focused editable field, text, selection, process and window; use include_ax=true and require background_keyboard_ready. Cmd/Ctrl/Alt shortcuts are refused. Windows/Linux background keyboard and type_text remain unsupported. No foreground/global-input fallback or automatic replay; verify the receipt and resulting state.

name: computer_query
description: Fast targeted accessibility lookup (no full tree or screenshot). Prefer this to clicking through lists when the control text or role is known. The app must already run. Returned indexes authorize only matched element actions in this turn. A truncated empty search does not prove absence. For settable text fields use computer_set_value instead of trying to establish keyboard focus.

text.description: Match text in the control's title, description or value (up to 1000 UTF-16 code units). Case-insensitive substring unless exact is true. Long fields are bounded and reported as truncated.

exact.description: Require a complete text match instead of a substring. Defaults to false. No substring retry.

max_nodes.description: Node/queue cap for AX traversal. Defaults to 500; capped at 5000. Search has a 2-second cooperative deadline.

app.description: Exact app identifier from computer_find_apps/computer_list_apps: macOS bundle ID or Windows/Linux PID; start_app uses the discovered launch_id on Windows/Linux. AIClaw Computer Use owns the observed target window. Self/helper/approval UI cannot be controlled.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 20; capped at 100.

role.description: Native accessibility role from this platform: macOS AXTextField/AXTextArea/AXButton, Windows Edit/Button, or Linux text/push button. Use roles returned by observation, not localized labels.

window_id.description: Native window_id from a prior observation/query. Search this window explicitly; omit to use the current app window.

name: computer_drag
description: Drag between screenshot pixel coordinates in the explicitly observed app window. Uses foreground event delivery and may move the system pointer. Verify the returned post-action state; never replay uncertain input.

name: computer_screenshot
description: Observe the app window and get observation_id. macOS defaults to a fast screenshot without a full AX tree; use computer_query to find named controls. Set include_ax=true only when you need a complete accessibility tree. After an action the returned screenshot already verifies its result; do not immediately repeat this read unless it is incomplete or the UI changed.

include_screenshot.description: Capture and return a screenshot. False skips capture and encoding; screenshot-coordinate actions require a fresh screenshot.

text_limit.description: Maximum text characters to return. Use "max" for full text. Defaults to 500.

max_tree_depth.description: Maximum accessibility tree depth to render. Defaults to 64.

include_ax.description: Include full accessibility tree. macOS defaults to false for speed; computer_query finds controls directly. Other platforms default to true.

app.description: Exact app identifier from computer_find_apps/computer_list_apps: macOS bundle ID or Windows/Linux PID; start_app uses the discovered launch_id on Windows/Linux. AIClaw Computer Use owns the observed target window. Self/helper/approval UI cannot be controlled.

max_tree_nodes.description: Maximum accessibility tree nodes to render. Defaults to 1200.

window_id.description: Native window_id from a prior observation/query. Search this window explicitly; omit to use the current app window.

name: computer_type
description: Insert literal text at the current editable focus using the latest observation_id. macOS interaction_mode=background requires a fresh screenshot with background_keyboard_ready (include_ax=true for complete focus evidence), unchanged text/selection, and at most 16000 UTF-16 units. Cocoa uses public PID-directed Unicode events; web plain fields use explicit AX literal insertion preserving surrounding text, and web text areas must be empty. Nonempty rich text areas are refused. These routes do not guarantee arbitrary app consumption; verify resulting text before submitting. No automatic retry or foreground fallback.
